.²1 Separation of the component parts of a compound, or of other grammatical forms.
.²2 The mark or interval of such a separation; {#samAse'vagraho hrasvasamakAlaH#}.
.²3 The syllable or letter after which such separation occurs, {#CandasyfdavagrahAt#}
 <ls>P. VIII. 4. 26</ls>.
.²4 A hiatus, absence of sandhi (as in {#Dik tAM ca taM ca madanaM ca imAM#}
 {#ca mAM ca#} instead of {#cemAM ca#}) <ls>Bh. 2. 2</ls>.
.²5 The mark ({#'#}) used to mark the elision of {#a#} after {#e#} and {#o#}.
.²6 Withholding of rain, drought, failure of rain; {#vfzwirBavati SasyAnAmavagrahaviSoziRAm#}
 <ls>R. 1. 62</ls>; {#rAvaRAvagrahaklAntamiti vAgamftena saH#} <ls n="R.">10. 48</ls>; {#naBonaBasyayorvfzwimavagraha#}
 {#ivAntare#} <ls n="R.">12. 29</ls>; {#vfzeva sItAM tadavagrahakzatAm#} <ls>Ku. 5. 61</ls>.
.²7 An obstacle, impediment, hindrance, restraint; {#saMsAra˚#} <ls>Māl. 1</ls>
 the bonds or fetters of worldly existence; {#prasahya rakzoBiravagrahaM#}
 {#ca#} <ls>Rām.</ls>; see {#anavagraha#} and {#niravagraha#}.
.²8 A herd of elephants
.²9 The forehead of an elephant; A part of the elephantʼs face, the flat
 level place in the middle of the elephantʼs forehead which joins the lower
 parts of the two Kumbhas; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 5. 6</ls>.
.²10 Nature, original temperament.
.²11 A sort of knowledge, a false idea.
.²12 Punishment (<ab>opp.</ab> {#anugraha#}); {#anugrahAvagrahayorviDAtA#} <ls>Śi. 1. 71</ls>.
.²13 An imprecation, a term of abuse.
.²14 An iron hook with which elephants are driven.
.²15 Obstinate insistance; obstinacy; {#karmaRyavagrahaDiyo BagavanvidAmaH#}
 <ls>Bhāg. 4. 7. 27</ls>.
